subject: Configuration proof and closure for scan findings - HeaterCorp request
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@heatercorp.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: security+audits@heatercorp.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for March scan

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Our security team completed a targeted external scan and a small penetration engagement against the Redwood endpoints in March. We need the following to close our internal audit: the redacted penetration test report (if possible), and concrete remediation evidence for the three medium findings scoped to auth/session handling, TLS configuration, and exposed management endpoints.

Specifically can you provide:
- Screenshots or console exports showing the fixed configuration (NACL/SG, load balancer TLS settings)
- Small config snippets (redact secrets) demonstrating TLS protocols/ciphers and any new hardened settings
- Ticket IDs or links for the remediation work and dates pushed to prod
- Any compensating controls if replacement fixes are scheduled later (WAF rules, rate limits, monitoring)

We also need a short mapping to SOC 2/SIG/CAIQ controls that these fixes touch so we can annotate our evidence tracker. If possible, please confirm that the fixes are live in production (not only staging).

Target: can you get this to us by EOD 15 Apr? We can accept a mix of attachments and Drive links.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Security Operations
HeaterCorp

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@heatercorp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for March scan

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes:
- We can provide a redacted executive summary of the pen test; the full raw report contains third-party tool output that we can sanitize.
- Neha will gather the config screenshots and ticket links; Vivek will confirm deployment timestamps and prod vs staging. Laura is helping validate the SOC 2/SIG mapping.

Action items for us (owner in parens):
1) Collect screenshots and config snippets from ops (Neha).
2) Export deploy manifests and prod timestamps (Vivek).
3) Prepare short control mapping to SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ (Laura).
4) Produce a one-page closure summary PDF (Markus).

We aim to have the package by EOD 15 Apr; if anything slips we'll flag it early.

-Markus
VP, Product @ Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@heatercorp.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for March scan

Alex / team — attaching the remediation artifacts we gathered today. Summary below.

Attachment: remediation-screenshots-20270415.zip (contains LB-TLS-20270414.png, NACL-rule-20270414.png, mgmt-endpoint-block.png)
Attachment: link to Jira INF-3421 (https://jira.redwoodinternal.com/browse/INF-3421) — this is the umbrella ticket; children INF-3423 (LB TLS hardening), INF-3424 (NACL tighten), INF-3425 (mgmt lockdown).

What we included:
- LB TLS: screenshot of load-balancer TLS policy set to TLSv1.2+ with AES-GCM ciphers. Small excerpt from prod manifest attached in the next email (we removed cert material).
- Network controls: screenshot of the updated NACL rule (deny 0.0.0.0/0 to management port range).
- Management endpoints: proof-of-blocking from WAF logs showing requests blocked to /admin from external IPs (sample log lines included).

Compensating controls (for any remaining low-risk items):
- WAF rule set tightened and rate limiting enabled at edge (applied 2027-04-13).
- Enhanced monitoring alert on anomalous session patterns and nightly token revocation job (INF-3425).

Notes: most fixes were deployed to production on 2027-04-14; INF-3421 shows deployment pipeline links and timestamps.

-Neha
Security Operations (Redwood)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@heatercorp.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: security+audits@heatercorp.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for March scan

Thanks Neha — this is helpful. Two follow-ups before we mark the packet complete:
1) Can we get a short, redacted config snippet showing the LB listener TLS protocol and cipher list (a 3–4 line snippet is fine), and a timestamped screenshot that proves the update is in the prod console (not the staging console)?
2) For the session/auth finding, could you provide a sample log (redacted) showing the token invalidation event after the revoke job ran on 2027-04-14? We need a time-correlated evidence line to show the control operated.

If you can provide those two items (attachment or Drive link) by EOB Mon 18 Apr we'll be able to close our tracker and update SOC 2/SIG references.

Appreciate it — Alex

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@heatercorp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for March scan

Alex — attaching the last items and confirming production. Summary of attachments: 
- prod-config-snippets.txt (contains redacted listener stanza: listener.port=443; listener.tls_protocols=TLS1.2,TLS1.3; ciphers=AES128-GCM-SHA256,AES256-GCM-SHA384)
- pt-closure-summary-20270418.pdf (one-page closure note mapping to SOC 2 CC6.7, SIG V2.0 section 5.1 and CAIQ network/asset controls)
- remediation-screenshots-20270415.zip (same as sent by Neha; included again for completeness)

Ticket references: INF-3421 (umbrella) and child INF-3423/3424/3425. Deploy pipeline shows jobs promoted to prod on 2027-04-14T02:43:12Z (see INF-3421 changeset).

Sample log line (redacted) showing token revocation executed:
[2027-04-14T02:45:22Z] service=sessionmgr instance=sess-17 action=token_revoke token_id=REDACTED user_id=usr-987 outcome=success

We confirm all fixes listed in the artifacts were applied to production. Where full production logs cannot be shared, we included redacted extracts and the Jira pipeline link for timestamp verification. If you need anything else we can provide a signed attestation from our SOC contact.

-Markus
VP, Product @ Redwood Inference
Attachments: prod-config-snippets.txt, pt-closure-summary-20270418.pdf, remediation-screenshots-20270415.zip
